title: Allow a delegation cwd in a linked git worktree of the project's repository
outcome: Reported by Engram::Opus (2026-09-25 ~03:4x UTC). termal_spawn_session for read-only reviewers (Codex and Claude, mode reviewer) with cwd C:\tmp\engram-family, a linked worktree of the Engram repository created with git worktree add, returned 400 'delegation cwd ... must stay inside project Engram' (containment check in src/delegations.rs:534 via src/paths.rs). Agents keep parallel changesets in linked worktrees outside the project folder because a worktree inside it shows up as an untracked directory and drifts the main worktree's review-freeze fingerprint and gate input (it invalidated one of Engram's gates). So reviewers cannot be pointed at a separate worktree. Suggested: accept a cwd that the project repository's own 'git worktree list --porcelain' reports as one of its worktrees (canonicalized, resolved off the state lock, same repository only, so project scoping still holds), or let a project declare extra allowed roots. Workaround meanwhile: a worktree inside the project under a gitignored directory (TermAl uses .tmp/).
